title: Judgment for 3 million yuan in compensation for using physical plugins to grab orders: The Supreme People's Court released 9 typical cases of anti-unfair competition, with AI and live streaming e-commerce as key focuses
summary: The Supreme People's Court released 9 typical cases of anti-unfair competition in 2026. In case five, an electronic company sold a "clicker" physical plugin that disrupted the fair competitive order of the food delivery platform, achieving sales of several million yuan and was ordered to compensate 3 million yuan. This case has exemplary significance in regulating unfair competition in the platform economy domain and maintaining healthy development.
